summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on September 10, 2026, for a $700 million offering of 5.750% senior unsecured notes due September 11, 2036, priced at 99.154% for net proceeds of about $690.9 million. The UK orthopedics company intends to use proceeds to fund purchases of its 2030 tender offer notes and related fees, with any remainder for general corporate purposes. Joint bookrunners include BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and SMBC Nikko. Notes carry a change-of-control put at 101%. Key angle: tender participation and take-up determine residual refinancing needs.
